Eigendecomposition of a Transition Matrix

Source: R/05_tools.R
Pdecomp.Rd

Computes the eigendecomposition of the transpose of a transition matrix.

Usage

Pdecomp(P)

Arguments

P

A square numeric transition matrix.

Value

An object of class "eigen" containing the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of t(P).

Details

The transpose is decomposed so that the resulting eigenvectors can be used to reconstruct powers of the original transition matrix with Ppower().

No validation is performed to confirm that P is stochastic or square. Invalid inputs are handled by base::eigen().

See also

base::eigen(), Ppower()

Examples

P <- matrix(c(0.8, 0.2, 0.3, 0.7), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
decomposition <- Pdecomp(P)
decomposition$values
#> [1] 1.0 0.5
